nodes.summary: In the admixture model, `C` is the `α : 1 - α` mixture of `A` and `B` plus its private edge.
nodes.title: Admixed population's weights in the admixture model

nodes.summary: Lineage weights of the admixture model: `A` and `B` sit on edges `0` and `1`, and `C` is an `α : 1 - α` mixture of `A` and `B` followed by drift on its private edge `2`.
nodes.title: Lineage weights of the three-population admixture model

nodes.summary: The centred leaf covariance from `f2`: `K` is half the double centring of the `f2` matrix, `K X Y = (f̄2 X· + f̄2 ·Y - f2 X Y - f̄2 ··) / 2`.
nodes.title: Centred leaf covariance as the double centring of f2

nodes.summary: The centred leaf covariance `K X Y = 𝔼[(p X - p̄) * (p Y - p̄)]`: the second moments of the frequencies centred across populations (not over `Ω`).
nodes.title: Centred leaf covariance

nodes.summary: `f2` from the centred leaf covariance: `f2 X Y = K X X + K Y Y - 2 K X Y`.
nodes.title: f2 from the centred leaf covariance

nodes.summary: f-statistics determine exactly the centred leaf covariance. f-statistics see a model only through its centred leaf covariance: two square-integrable frequency models have the same `f2` at every pair (hence the same `f3` and `f4`, by `f3_eq_f2` and `f4_eq_f2`) if and only if they have the same centred leaf covariance.
nodes.title: f-statistics determine exactly the centred leaf covariance

nodes.summary: The star tree and the admixture model have the same `f2` at every pair of populations.
nodes.title: Star tree and admixture model have equal f2

nodes.summary: The star tree and the admixture model have the same `f4` (hence the same `f3`) at every quadruple of populations.
nodes.title: Star tree and admixture model have equal f4

nodes.summary: The star-tree model has binary loadings.
nodes.title: Star-tree model has binary loadings

nodes.summary: For `α ∉ {0, 1}` the admixture model does not have binary loadings.
nodes.title: Admixture model lacks binary loadings

nodes.summary: The mean frequency `p̄ ω = (1 / n) ∑ X, p X ω` across the `n` populations.
nodes.title: Mean frequency across populations

nodes.summary: The matching star tree has nonnegative edge lengths when `0 ≤ α ≤ 1`, `a, b ≥ 0`, and the private drift of `C` is at least `α (1 - α)(a + b)`, i.e. when `f3 C A B ≥ 0` in the admixture model.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the matching star-tree edge lengths

nodes.summary: Edge lengths of the star tree matching the admixture model with edge lengths `a`, `b`, `c`: `(1 - α)(a + b)`, `α (a + b)` and `c - α (1 - α)(a + b)`.
nodes.title: Edge lengths of the star tree matching an admixture model

nodes.summary: Lineage weights of the star tree on three populations `0 = A`, `1 = B`, `2 = C`: edge `e` is the leaf edge of population `e`.
nodes.title: Lineage weights of the three-population star tree

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
